description: AstratechX, insanlığın Ay ve Mars'ta bıraktığı ekipmanların bilimsel hikayesini dijitalleştiren yenilikçi bir takımdır. NASA açık verileriyle etkileşimli bir uzay mirası deneyimi tasarlıyoruz. Ekibimize katılmak isteyenlerde özellikle; içerik/senaryo yazımı, web geliştirme, grafik tasarım veya dijital modelleme yetkinlikleri arıyoruz. Uzay tarihini birlikte anlatmak isteyen herkese kapımız açık!
summary:
Silent Ambassadors: The Sleepers Beneath the Stars" is an interactive digital storybook chronicling the pioneering spacecraft and rovers that completed their missions and fell silent across distant celestial bodies. Through a blend of scientific accuracy and engaging storytelling, the project brings together space history's silent witnesses—from the electric Lunar Roving Vehicles of the Apollo missions and Mars's first micro-rover, Sojourner, to the Huygens probe resting on Saturn’s moon, Titan.
Because public attention in space exploration primarily focuses on active missions, the historical and emotional significance of the hardware left behind on other worlds is often overlooked. This book addresses that challenge by transforming complex aerospace history into an accessible, inspiring narrative that fosters empathy and curiosity among readers of all ages.
Ultimately, this project is vital because it cultivates awareness of space heritage—reminding us that these silent pioneers are not mere space debris, but humanity’s first monuments of courage that must be preserved as open-air museums for future generations.
details:
The Sleepers Beneath the Stars" is an interactive digital storybook that tells the story of pioneering spacecraft that completed their missions and fell silent across different celestial bodies, keeping alive the memory of cosmic envoys resting in distant corners of the solar system. Composed of five thematic chapters, the story traces humanity's first footprints on other worlds and emphasizes that space exploration is not limited to active missions. From the electric rovers in the golden dust of the Moon to Mars's tiny Sojourner, and from the Huygens probe on Titan's methane shores to future open-air museums, the narrative blends scientific accuracy with emotional storytelling.

💻 Tech Stack

  • StoryJumper / Interactive Digital Storytelling Platform
  • AI-Assisted Visual Design & Custom Illustration Tools
  • Cross-Device Compatible (Responsive) Digital Book Interface
  • Interactive Page-Turning & Visual-First Layout

Innovation Highlights

  • 📖 Narrative Design: Structured as an immersive and emotional journey across five thematic chapters set on different celestial bodies.
  • 🔭 Educational Value: Each chapter introduces historic space missions (Apollo LRV, Sojourner, Huygens) alongside concepts of space archaeology and cultural heritage.
  • 🎨 Visual Simplicity: High-contrast space illustrations and clear typography that reflect the depth and solitude of the cosmos.
  • 📡 Data Integrity: All mission timelines, hardware specifications, and scientific facts are sourced directly from NASA and ESA archives.
